prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofer, but **Art’s Roofing & Construction** looks like a strong candidate for a Miami hurricane-rated replacement: it lists Florida contractor licenses **CCC1333598** and **CGC1541858**, says it handles permits, and specifies Miami-Dade NOA-approved products for the High-Velocity Hurricane Zone. [Art’s Roofing—Miami](https://www.artsroofing.com/areas/miami/)

I’d get at least two more bids before choosing. **3MG Roofing & Solar** is another option to compare; it says it is licensed and insured, GAF Master Elite certified, and installs HVHZ-compliant materials. [3MG—Miami](https://3mg.com/location/miami-fl/)

For any contractor, verify the license and insurance independently, then ask for a written scope naming the exact roof system and its current Miami-Dade NOA or Florida Product Approval, permit and inspection responsibilities, fastening and underlayment details, and workmanship and manufacturer warranties. Don’t rely on “hurricane-rated” as a standalone promise.
